speaker: Doctor
text: Please tell me, did you notice any sensory changes like tingling, loss of vibration sense, or difficulty with proprioception in your feet and legs? Also, have you ever been told you had a vitamin B12 deficiency or pernicious anemia?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That clumsy feeling on the right side suggests a focal issue; have you experienced any weakness or numbness specifically in your right hand or leg? Additionally, do you have any history of long-term alcohol use, diabetes, or autoimmune conditions?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Vitamin B12 deficiency secondary to Crohn's disease and Natalizumab therapy leading to Subacute Combined Degeneration of the spinal cord.

REQUEST TEST: Serum B12 level, Methylmalonic acid, and Homocysteine levels.
